simple.meaning: שָׁסַס (shâçaç) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to plunder.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 5 times in Judges, 1 Samuel, Psalms, Isaiah, Zechariah, beginning at Judges 2:14. The surrounding contexts include city, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁסַס (H8155) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׁסַס (shâçaç) / H8155 is traced through Judges 2:14, 1 Samuel 17:53, Psalms 89:42, Isaiah 13:16 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H8155. shasas [ שָׁסַס ] verb id. (|| from of שׁסה ); — Qal Perfect 3plural שַׁסֻּ֫הוּ Psa 89:42 they have plundered him; Imperfect 3masculine plural וַיָּשֹׁ֫סּוּ Judg 2:14 (accusative of person); 1Sam 17:53 (accusative of location); participle suffix שֹׁאֲסַיִךְ Jer 30:16 Kt (Qr see שׁסה ), Aramaic form, Ges § 67s . Niph`al be plundered, rifled , of houses: Perfect 3plural consecutive וְנָשַׁ֫סּוּ Zech 14:2 ; Imperfect 3masculine plural יִשַּׁ֫סּוּ Isa 13:16 .

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.
The children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines and they plundered their camp.
You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries.
Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.

For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.
